items.text: Round-1 decisions (d1=A service.json metadata, d2=B always modal dialog, d3=A two sequential calls, d4=A show-assigned-with-badge) are now woven into the plan: §5 Scope, §7 Target End State, §8 Implementation Strategy, and §9 Contract Decisions. Round-2 d1=A (add @radix-ui/react-dialog and components/ui/dialog.tsx) is incorporated into §6 Current Technical Context and §8 Phase 3.

The plan_updates field of round-002 had described a Greenfield Constraint section, an ApplyPreview refactor as a new phase, the GET /api/v1/brands/{id}/assignments endpoint, and a vrooli scenario restart step — but those changes had not actually been applied to plan.md. They are applied now: §3 Greenfield Constraint, §8 Phase 5 (ApplyPreview refactor), §7 Phase 2 + §9 + §10 (new endpoint), §11 (restart step).

Round-2 decisions d2 (default elements on auto-assignment), d3 (how the detail page fetches the brand's assignment), and d4 (reassignment confirmation UX) were not selected. Rather than blocking finalization, the plan documents the assumed recommendation for each in §15 Open Decisions Carried Forward, names the exact section to revisit if the user chooses differently, and proceeds. If the user prefers explicit answers before execution, run another normal workshop round on round-002 first.

Initiative context: brand-manager-readiness has 4 members (1 completed, 3 pending). The sibling execute/brand-manager-discovery-import-ui will likely consume the same GET /api/v1/scenarios endpoint and ScenarioPicker primitive being introduced here — §16 Initiative Context flags this for the orchestrator so the two items can be sequenced (this one first) and the discovery-import UI can reuse rather than reinvent. No upstream/downstream initiatives, so no cross-initiative sequencing risks beyond the sibling-overlap note.

Readiness scoring rationale: problem_clarity=3 (well understood and grounded in named files), scope_defined=3 (acceptance_allow on spec.json plus explicit in/out lists in §5), approach_solid=3 (six concrete phases with named files and steps), testable=3 (named Go and Vitest tests in §10 with concrete cases). risk_awareness held at 2 because the plan still relies on assumed answers for the three unselected round-2 decisions; lifting it to 3 would require those answers or a tighter mitigation matrix around them.

plan_updates: Applied the round-002 plan_updates that were previously declared but not actually written to plan.md: added §3 Greenfield Constraint, added §8 Phase 5 (ApplyPreview refactor) and Phase 6 (cleanup + vrooli scenario restart brand-manager), added the GET /api/v1/brands/{id}/assignments endpoint to §5 Scope, §7 Target End State, §8 Phase 2, §9 Contract Decisions, and §10 Testing Plan, and added components/ui/dialog.tsx + @radix-ui/react-dialog to §6 Current Technical Context and §8 Phase 3. Added §15 Open Decisions Carried Forward documenting the three unanswered round-002 decisions and their default assumptions, and §16 Initiative Context flagging the sibling overlap with execute/brand-manager-discovery-import-ui.
